note: Pre-registered assumption ranges for the Sobol / tornado analysis (spec analyses/M712_spec.md Rev 1 section 6) and the scenario shift table; hashed by the spec; prototype ranges from analyses/exposure_scenarios_2026-11-16/results/sensitivity.json except tau_p and off_w (re-centred on M709)

Ea_age.meaning: Arrhenius activation energy of the ageing dose, kJ/mol (literature range, not identified here)

winter_shift.meaning: Dec-Feb ambient shift vs the repo normal, C (Nov and Mar half): severe to mild winter

off_w.meaning: parked pack above ambient, one offset all seasons, C; M709 fit 0.469 C [-0.578, 1.407]; bracket lower bound 0 (owner prior: parked at or above ambient), upper bound 2.7 (autumn upper limit +1.8 [0.8, 2.7] of the restart-temperature handoff)

tau_p.meaning: parked cool-down time constant, h; re-centred on the M709 fit (analyses/M709/park_model.json: 9.105 h [8.19, 10.16]); upper range wide for wind / snow

w_off.meaning: share of summer-pattern (long-trip) days in Oct-Apr: gap / trip-pattern assumption

EaR.meaning: activation energy of the resistance proxy used for I^2R heat below the observed range, kJ/mol (fit 17.6)

der.meaning: multiplier on the linearly extrapolated BMS charge limit below 20 C (3 = effectively no derating)

kappa.meaning: Ah-throughput increase per C of cooling below 15 C (data: not distinguishable from 0; M28: 0.006-0.016)

c1.meaning: slope of the in-drive coolant-air temperature on ambient (fit 0.22 [0.17, 0.28])

f_a.meaning: unlogged-distance factor of AUTUMN-pattern days (odometer / logged); summer-pattern days use f_s, derived from the odometer of the summer window and held fixed (not ranged)

amp_w_scale.meaning: winter diurnal ambient amplitude relative to autumn

gamma.meaning: SoC weighting exponent of the parked calendar term exp(gamma (SoC-50)/100)

targetsDistanceTilt.S2: odometer lifetime mean from the dash odometer at the latest ingestion
